data.gender_notes: Eudo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘eudos’, meaning ‘good, prosperous, or fortunate’. This name was given to children born into wealthy families or those who were believed to bring good fortune. The name Eudo carries the meaning “Rich in wealth” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eudo usually hope their child will grow to embody rich in wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
